overview: The letters describe the 2008 credit crisis as a freeze in credit markets with falling home and stock prices, a freefall in business activity and a later Treasury bond bubble. Berkshire's credit-default contracts lost $2.5 billion in the panic, yet its liquidity let it invest $15.6 billion in 25 days after the Lehman bankruptcy.

timeline.point: The credit crisis and tumbling home and stock prices produced a paralyzing fear and a freefall in business activity.
timeline.quote:
the credit crisis, coupled with tumbling home and stock prices, had produced a
paralyzing fear that engulfed the country

timeline.point: Investors went from underpricing risk to overpricing it, producing a Treasury bond bubble.
timeline.quote: The investment world has gone from underpricing risk to overpricing it.

timeline.point: Credit-default contracts paid $2.5 billion in losses during the panic but should still earn an underwriting profit.
timeline.quote: A number of the companies in the high-yield indices failed, which required us to pay losses of $2.5 billion.

timeline.point: Berkshire's strength let it invest $15.6 billion in 25 days of panic.
timeline.quote: That’s what allowed us to invest $15.6 billion in 25 days of panic following the Lehman bankruptcy in 2008.

overview: Buffett's one airline investment, USAir preferred stock, soured soon after the purchase: industry economics deteriorated through kamikaze pricing and merger turmoil. He calls it an unforced error and the investment less secure than when made, while expecting it to work out unless the industry is decimated.

timeline.point: Buffett bought USAir at the moment it hit severe problems, calling it an unforced error.
timeline.quote: I plunged into the business at almost the exact moment that it ran into severe problems.

timeline.point: Airline economics deteriorated at an alarming pace because of kamikaze pricing.
timeline.quote: the economics of the airline industry have deteriorated at an alarming pace

timeline.point: The investment should work out all right unless the industry is decimated, but is less secure than when made.
timeline.quote: our investment is now less secure than at the time I made it
